review.summary: Assessment contains 23 questions with correct mathematical answers and appropriate difficulty for grade 12. However, significant structural issues exist: questions 9a/9b duplicate 5a/5b, and questions 10a/10b duplicate 8a/8b, violating the no-repetition requirement. Question 7a has ambiguous wording about coffee-tea beverage combinations. All probability calculations and counting techniques are mathematically correct.
